outcome: feasibility of transpubic ultrasound imaging to visualise the process of voiding
dynamics of the vesicourethral sphincter, the urethra and pelvic floor muscles during initiation, duration and cessation of micturition
voiding patterns at different stages throughout a single adult female subject's reproductive years and postpartum recovery
cohort: One female subject with no urinary symptoms was recruited and scanned from age 36 to age 46
finding: This study demonstrated that the transpubic scanning technique is feasible, reproducible, can document dynamic and measurable data, demonstrates consistency in data over time, and that image criteria are reproducible on different ultrasound machines.
mod_finding: Maximum urethral mobility was seen after the second childbirth, when the subject reported stress urinary incontinence.
